title: ASEM Human Rights Seminar 2026 in Mongolia
description: Apply to attend the 24th Informal ASEM Human Rights Seminar on making rights protection effective from local to global level. Open to citizens of ASEM Partner countries.
descriptionDetailed: The Asia-Europe Foundation co-hosts this seminar with Mongolia's National Human Rights Commission and Ministry of Foreign Affairs, bringing human rights experts, civil society, and academics from Asia and Europe to Ulaanbaatar. Selected civil society participants receive funded participation covering accommodation, meals, and economy-class airfare reimbursement. A follow-on capacity-building training runs for two days after the seminar.

entry.feeNote: There is no registration or participation fee; selected participants receive funded accommodation, meals, and economy airfare reimbursement.

prize.description: Selected civil society participants receive fully funded participation including hotel accommodation, meals during program days, and reimbursement of economy-class airfare up to a specified ceiling.

audience.eligibilityLabel: Open to citizens of ASEM Partner countries
audience.eligibilityDetail: Applicants need working proficiency in English and demonstrated knowledge of or interest in human rights. Civil society participants are selected via open application or invitation, while government representatives are nominated by their ASEM partner governments.
